༄༅/ /lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ /༈/oṃ swa sti/gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde ba che/ /skad cig nyid la 'char bar mdzad pa yi/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde ba che// skad cig nyid la 'char bar mdzad pa yi// rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma la btud nas// lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bshad//

'dir rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa la dngos su gnang ba'i gdams ngag zab mo nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod na/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ dpal he ru ka dang bla ma tha mi dad pa mdun du spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ gus 'dud drag po byas te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag nyid la thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje sogs nas/ lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ rang gi lus skad cig gis dkyil 'khor lus dkyil las 'byung ba ltar/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom pa nas/ rkang mthil gnod mdzes su bsam pa'i bar shin tu gsal bar bsgoms nas/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma nas rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam pa can/ nang zab mo lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa/ 'og ma'i spyi bor gong ma bzhugs pa tho brtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs par gyur par bsams la/ de rnams la mos gus drag tu bya zhing*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol pa btab pas bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa bsdus nas bla ma rnams la thim par bsgom/ de nas rdo rje 'chang bdag med ma la thim/ de bir+wa pa la/ de rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la thim/ de slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la/

de rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ de chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la/ de tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal ba la/ de nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la/ de grub chen brag phug pa chen po la/ de bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ de bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ de grub chen bud+dha shrī la/ de rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la/ de sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la/ de bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan la/ de rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma la/ de tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho la/ de 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la/ de mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan la/ de khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan la/ de mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la/ de rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la/ de mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub la/ de ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la/ de ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas la/ de ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la/ de byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med la/ de byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin la/ de byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ de bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ de blo gros snying po la/ de ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po la/ de drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dpal 'bar phrin las bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po la thim/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pa'i bar byas nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ bla ma dam pas bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus na rnam par snang mdzad yab yum dang*/ rtsa 'dab rnams la lha mo so gnyis yod pa la thim par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ rlung bum pa can bzung la/ byang sems des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/

lus kyi dri ma dag lus rtsa gnas gyur/ sprul sku thob par gyur par bsam mo// yang spyi bo'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ bla ma dam pas bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi chu rgyun byung*/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la thim par gyur par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ bum pa can bzung la/ byang sems kyis mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag ngag yi ge gnas gyur/ longs sku thob par gyur par bsam mo// de bzhin du bla ma dam pas bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yang sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi chu rgyun byung*/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la thim par gyur par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ bum pa can bzung la/ byang sems kyis snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag yid bdud rtsi gnas gyur/ chos sku thob par gyur par bsam mo// de bzhin du bla ma dam pas bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yab yum bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas/ lte ba dang*/ gsang gnas dang*/ dbang po dang*/ yan lag gi lha rnams la thim par gyur par bsams la/ lha rnams gsal gdab/ bum pa can byas la/ byang sems des spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sgo gsum yon tan bya byed dang bcas pa rlung gnas gyur ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob par gyur par bsam mo// de nas lta ba ci nus su bskyangs la dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o// de ltar na dbang bzhi po re re la'ang lam bzhi char tshang ba yin te/ lha'i rnam pa la sems 'dzin pa bum dbang gi lam/ rlung bum pa can du bya ba gsang dbang gi lam/ rang rang gi 'khor lo rnams byang sems kyis khyab par byas pa gsum pa'i lam/ de dag las lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes pa ni bzhi pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro//

//zab mo nang gi bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs// snyan brgyud yi ger bris la nyes pa gang*// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar bdag 'chags shing*// dge bas dpal ldan bla ma mnyes byed shog /nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gdams ngag lam 'bras kyi bcud bsdus pa lta bu 'di ni/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bran du gyur pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// mchan 'di rnams mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs mtshams sbyor sogs las btus te rang gi rgyun gyi nyams len ltar 'du gsum pa ngag dbang legs pas bris pa'o// //dge 'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
